verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's homepage claims first-party agents that monitor the product continuously and proactively surface insights. That is a product-native background capability, but it is a single marketing line with no documentation on how users configure, schedule or trigger these automations, or what actions they can take. Warehouse sync, export APIs and MCP query tools are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation setup, recurring schedules/triggers, autonomous actions beyond surfacing insights, first-party technical docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next.
